descriptionChirho: A tooth or teeth as a part of the body, used literally for biting, gnashing, or in the lex talionis ('tooth for tooth'), with various possessive and prepositional inflections.
Ivory as a precious material derived from elephant tusks, used for decorative or luxury items such as thrones, palaces, and inlaid work.
A jagged rock formation or cliff resembling a tooth, as in the rocky crags of a mountain pass or wilderness terrain.
A pointed projection on an implement or tool, such as the prongs of a flesh-fork used in sacrificial service.
